reviewer: main conversation agent; no extra teacher or generation
rationale: The existing Pennsylvania projection now contains only its independently applicable general-property alternative. Two new EV-only units carry the apparel decision and the remaining narrow personal-property alternatives. This is a real one-to-three edit-unit decomposition, not a replacement ID for the same whole catalogue.

The supplied section 8123 grants 300 per spouse; the existing benchmark whole-asset, equal-joint treatment of 300/600 is retained. Section 8124 lists apparel, Bibles/school books, qualifying sewing machines and actual uniform/accoutrement, without a dollar ceiling. The candidate preserves these categories and states whole-asset value only for qualifying alternatives.

Other legal namespaces and the global independent-exemption guidance are unchanged. Empty operators and original task/public-jurisdiction projection remain the only execution path. No extra model step or host computation is introduced.

The change also makes previously implicit uncapped valuation and narrow-category exclusions more explicit. Any observed gain belongs to this combined teaching proposal; this pilot alone cannot identify granularity as the sole causal factor.
